name: poa_dev
description: Proof-of-address DEV (README, testdata/POA.md): 200 documents of the three layouts held out of training, 100 genuine and 25 of each negative case, each a burst of 4 camera frames.

args: poa_synth.render_one(11, i, LAYOUTS, 2026-10-15) for the held-out layouts' indices < 2000

licence: Synthetic, generated by this repository's own code (MIT OR Apache-2.0); every holder is fictional. Place names and postal codes from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).
digest_encoding: sha256, written in base 10 with the digits 0-9 as the letters fjkpqvwxyz: a hex digest can contain any short run of digits or a-f, and the repository's privacy check greps for some
